en: The image is of a historical wooden house, partially encased or preserved within a brick structure. Visible are old wooden window frames and a plaque with names and dates inside what looks like a museum or a protective building. The plaque has inscriptions in Dutch and mentions notable historical figures. The text on the lower left reads 'ZAANDAM Czaar Peter huisje', indicating a specific site. The overall color and style suggest the postcard dates from the early to mid-20th century.
